_comment: General-purpose Neo L2 — the safe default. Settlement is an SP1 validity proof, so a batch is final when the proof verifies: no honest-challenger assumption and no window to wait out. securityLevel=Optimistic is the floor the chain advertises (doc.md §16.2) and proofType=Zk over-delivers on it — of the pairings SettlementManager.IsProofTypeCompatible accepts, it is the only one the shipped production hub can also verify. NeoFS DA is the canonical N4 data-availability tier (Neo-native, retrievable, content-addressed); dBFT committee for local finality; delayed exit gives the operator a settlement window. See samples/README.md.
